verdict.rationale: jo's own docs say users can give jo a job and a schedule and receive recurring outputs such as a weekly plan or morning priorities without asking each time. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. Overnight autonomous work on its always-on cloud machine backs this up. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how schedules are set up, edited and managed (cadence options, multi-step workflows), and independent or hands-on confirmation that scheduled jobs run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Give jo a job and a schedule. Get a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time.
because jo has its own machine, it can work overnight: read what came in, watch what changed, and prepare your morning before you wake.
